extractions.value: TMS revealed distinctive MEP pattern in proximal lower limb muscles: markedly increased MEP amplitudes and MEP/M ratios, reduced excitability thresholds, absent silent period. MEP latencies, central and peripheral conduction times and amplitudes by magnetic spinal root stimulation were normal. Treatment with benzodiazepine and baclofen normalized clinical picture and MEP values.
